_readme.title: Vayu Roadmap
_readme.howto: To update the site: change ONLY the 'status' field of a phase or subphase. Nothing else.

phase_status.completed: ✓ Done. Green check on the timeline.
phase_status.working: ● Currently being built. Red pulsing dot.
phase_status.soon: — Planned, not started yet. Grey dash.
phase_status.skipped: ⏭ Skipped for now. Completed subphases, but deferred until a later phase.

subphase_status.deferred: ⏸ Pushed to a later phase. Hollow dot.

subphases.name: QBE codegen — statements, control flow, functions
Lists, maps, indexing, builtins, string methods
Interprocedural escape — argument flow through user functions
Field-level escape — partial escape of struct fields
Loop-aware escape — hoist allocations out of loops
nva v1 — new, init, build, run, clean
nva add, nva remove, nva list, nova.lock
HTTP registry client, nva publish, semver resolution
regex — match, search, find_all, replace, fields
crypto — sha256, md5, hmac, base64, random_bytes
os — getenv, setenv, platform, hostname, chdir
math extras — asin, acos, atan2, sinh, degrees, hypot, …
Base: def, if/elif/else, while, for, class/struct, import, try/except/finally, raise
Type parameters on def/class, constraints <T: Base>
Substitution and unify in the type checker
Type parameter parsing in self-hosted compilers
Inspection — hash, id, callable, isinstance, issubclass, getattr, hasattr, dir, repr
Pure helpers — enumerate, zip, reversed, round, pow, divmod, sign, gcd, lcm, clamp
String refinements — capitalize, title, swapcase, center, ljust, rjust, zfill, count, rfind, partition, rpartition, splitlines, rsplit, is_lower/upper/alnum/ascii
List refinements — extend, count, reverse, sort, copy, first, last
Native list.sort → merge sort (O(n log n))
Map refinements — set, get_or, pop, pop_or, update, copy, has_key, items
Tuple unpacking — a, b, c = t, for (k, v) in pairs:
Native set ops — union, intersection, difference
Extended math — comb, perm, isqrt, factorial, cbrt, expm1, log1p, copysign, fabs, tgamma, lgamma, erf, erfc, tau, inf, nan
C FFI codegen — QBE call, str ↔ char* bridge, VAYU_FFI_LIBS
True aliasing for &x — heap cell shared across all backends
Native pointer arithmetic — p + n, p[i], p[i] = v
Tree/VM pointer arithmetic via backing-array model
FFI structs by value (≤8-byte single-field classes)
CPython dynamic-load shim, import py, py.init / py.version / py.run
DLL discovery — python313.dll direct, LoadLibraryEx altered search path
Calling Python — py.import, py.getattr, py.call, py.decref
Tuple literals, tuple unpack, set literals
lambda, visibility modifiers, static members, type params on def/class
Formatter — vfmt with idempotent rules (indent, spacing, blank-line policy)
Linter — unused names, unreachable code, shadowing, dead stores
VS Code extension — bundle 18.1–18.3, syntax highlighting, run/debug

Bitmap I/O — WIC BMP/PNG/JPG load, draw, alpha, PNG save

phases.name: Graphics 3D

subphases.name: Math library — Vec2/3/4, Mat4, Quat and helpers (Vayu stdlib)

phases.name: AI / ML
phases.description: Vayu-first tensor and ML stack with native hot loops; GPU acceleration remains optional.

NN primitives — Parameter, Linear, activations, losses, optimizers, Sequential

phases.name: Single-binary native toolchain
phases.description: Package ecosystem and dependency management — local registry first, then HTTP, Git, and transitive resolution.

subphases.name: Semver in nva.vyu — landed last drop
Local registry folder, nva publish-local / nva install
Reference server — pure Vayu HTTP daemon

phases.name: Native floats
phases.description: Native Vayu currently has no real float type: values are i64, arithmetic is integer-only, and floating-point values are rounded or rejected. This phase adds native floating-point support before benchmarking.

subphases.name: Float type + ABI — native float values, cross-backend representation, arithmetic (+ - * / // % **), comparisons, unary negate, int → float widening on mixed ops, print formatting
Math library + collections — native math.* functions, list<float>, map<str, float>, float(x), int(x), str(x) round-trips
Tensor migration — move tensor internals from Q16.16 to f32 or f64; retain Q16.16 as a compatibility layer temporarily, then retire it

phases.name: Benchmarking (Round 1, pre-VCB)
phases.description: Benchmark suite and all planned subphases are complete, but the full Round 1 comparison is intentionally skipped for now. Benchmarking is postponed until after VCB so the published results use the final backend.

subphases.name: Harness + control programs — runner plus arith, fib, startup
Compute-heavy set — matmul (512×512), nbody (5-body, 1M steps), mandelbrot (2000×2000)
Allocation-heavy set — string_concat (100k +=), hashmap (1M str→int insert/lookup), json_parse (10 MB), sort (10M ints)

phases.name: VCB
phases.description: Vayu Compiler Backend — a separate native backend project, progressing from a shared compiler IR and lowering pipeline to direct machine-code generation.

rootPhases.name: Part 1: backend foundation
rootPhases.description: Establish VCB as a separate backend with its shared IR, lowering pipeline, printer, and inspection tooling before machine-code generation.

subphases.name: VCB project, IR, parser, printer, and vcb dump
Lowering pipeline and Vayu integration boundary

rootPhases.name: Part 2: native code generation
rootPhases.description: Complete the VCB native backend and move Vayu from the QBE + gcc pipeline to direct VCB-built binaries.

subphases.name: x86-64 integer codegen, PE writer, vcb build
Control flow in x64: jmp/br/phi, block labels, alloca/load/store, setcc fix
Vayu AST → VCB IR: int arithmetic, def/return, print/exit
Vayu AST → VCB IR: if/elif/else, while, for-range, break/continue
Bool printing, string literals, .text-tail string section, vayu_print_str; awaiting Step 3 verification
Cutover: VCB default; QBE+gcc opt-in fallback

phases.name: ELF writer + PE correctness
phases.description: Phase 27 expanded from an ELF writer to include the PE correctness work required before shipping the shared x64 codegen path.

subphases.name: Diagnosis: PE 'Access is denied'
subphases.description: Runtime.cpp build fix for duplicate emitStrLen and jgShort; automatically create the output directory.

subphases.name: ELF writer Part 1
subphases.description: Add include/vcb/Elf.hpp, src/elf/Elf.cpp, codegenX64Elf, --target elf, and Linux syscall runtime support for exit, print_char, print_ln, print_space, print_bool, print_str, and print_int.

subphases.name: vcb elfheaders
subphases.description: Add a structural ELF validator for environments without a Linux host.

subphases.name: Linux runtime Part 2
subphases.description: Add vayu_alloc (brk bump); list new/push/get/set/len; map new/put/get/has/len; string len/eq/starts_with/ends_with/contains/find/upper/lower; print_list/print_map; extend dependency closure.

subphases.name: PE padding heuristic
subphases.description: Use SizeOfImage / 4 as the minimum file size; show the ratio in vcb headers.

subphases.name: PE correctness
subphases.description: Disable DYNAMIC_BASE and HIGH_ENTROPY_VA (0x8100); set IMAGE_FILE_RELOCS_STRIPPED (characteristics 0x0023); use a non-zero timestamp and dynamic section list (skip empty .rdata); reserve 32-byte shadow space in vayu_exit; make writePe take PeInputs& so RVAs are outputs; upgrade vcb headers to report ERROR/WARN validation results.

subphases.name: Real .reloc + Base Relocation Directory
subphases.description: Emit IMAGE_REL_BASED_DIR64 entries for every absolute address in .text. The four hardcoded 64-bit mov rax, imm64 instructions in emitPrintBool/emitPrintFloat are the only candidates; string-literal lea rip+disp and IAT call [rip+disp] are RIP-relative. Re-enable DYNAMIC_BASE and HIGH_ENTROPY_VA after this lands.

subphases.name: .pdata/.xdata unwind metadata
subphases.description: Emit a RUNTIME_FUNCTION table for each non-leaf function using push rbp; mov rbp, rsp; sub rsp, N, with .xdata UNWIND_INFO using UWOP_PUSH_NONVOL (rbp) and UWOP_ALLOC_SMALL. Required for correct Windows x64 exceptions; currently untested and structurally missing.

subphases.name: Replace msvcrt.dll with kernel32 heap APIs
subphases.description: Use kernel32!HeapAlloc, HeapReAlloc, and HeapFree; obtain the heap with GetProcessHeap during one-time initialization or pass it thread-locally. Remove msvcrt.dll from .idata.

subphases.name: Linux vayu_print_float
subphases.description: Port emitPrintFloat to syscall-only output, retaining the six-decimal trimming algorithm.

subphases.name: Consolidate Asm/FunctionEmitter
subphases.description: Extract the duplicated implementations from src/x64/X64.cpp (PE) and src/x64/X64Elf.cpp (ELF) into src/x64/X64Common.hpp with no behavior change.

subphases.name: PE test matrix
subphases.description: Test 11 programs: empty main, arithmetic, print int/string/bool, list create/push, multiple runtime calls, string constants, larger .text, and multiple imports. Each must pass vcb headers with zero errors/warnings, launch on Windows, exit as expected, and produce expected stdout.

subphases.name: Linux test matrix
subphases.description: Run the same 11 programs built with --target elf under a Docker Desktop Linux container; verify expected exit codes and stdout.

subphases.name: ASLR verification
subphases.description: After 27.5, rebuild with ASLR enabled and confirm the loader accepts images relocated to different bases across multiple runs.

subphases.name: Version cut
subphases.description: Bump VCB to 0.5.0, update README, and freeze Phase 27.

phases.name: Full benchmarking on VCB-built binaries
phases.description: Run the full benchmark harness after VCB-built binaries are ready.

subphases.name: Full benchmark suite — Vayu VCB-built binaries against C++, Java, and Python
Before/after comparison — compare VCB results with the postponed QBE-era baseline when available
Publish benchmark summary and regression analysis

phases.name: Version cut
phases.description: Cut the VCB-era release after backend integration and benchmarking.

subphases.name: Bundle VCB-era toolchain and runtime for supported platforms
Retire QBE + gcc from the native toolchain documentation and packaging
Publish benchmark results and tag the release
